title: Unable to play Ads at 35 minutes and 47 seconds and above
body:
### Issue description
Problem is in _ImaAdsLoader_ at line 1541. When play an Ad at 35 minutes and 47 seconds and above, value _adPodTimeUs_ is always 2147483647 (int max).

### Reproduction steps
Play an Ad at 40 or 50 minutes.

### Link to test content
